about: Every number this video shows or says, with its source. Checked by the facts gate against the source page; from video/studio/research/runs/2026-10-28-topic-bank.md (topic 4, Brief 4) and re-read on the source page on Oct 28, 2026.

servicetitan.title: Trades Industry Trends: Call Booking, Close Rates & Off-Hours Calls
servicetitan.quoteMedian: Regional median close rates range from 31% in the Northeast to 38% in the West.
servicetitan.quoteTop: Among the top 25% of businesses by close rate in each region, medians range from 70% to 73%.
servicetitan.window: May through July 2026 (the most recent quarter; the page draws on five quarters, May 2025 through July 2026)
servicetitan.population: an aggregated, de-identified sample of ServiceTitan customer accounts (trades businesses); which trades, and residential or commercial, not stated
servicetitan.caveat: The page does not define close rate. It says the data should not be interpreted as representative of the entire trades industry, specific trades, broader populations or general market conditions; comparisons are not a guarantee of results and do not establish causation.
servicetitan.method: Call booking and close rates are calculated based on the median of the sampled population and the median of the top 25% of that population.

example.source: OURS: a worked example of the formula, labeled 'example' on screen and in the voice; not a finding
example.formula: close rate = jobs sold / estimates given, both counted over the same month
example.dollarFormula: dollar close rate = dollars sold / dollars quoted
example.check: 14 / 40 = 0.35 = 35%, which sits inside the 31% to 38% range of regional medians
